Title: Credential Interception
Description: User credentials could be intercepted if HTTPS or certificate setup fails.
Possible Mitigation(s): Force HTTPS 443, HSTS, redirect HTTP?HTTPS, certificate monitoring.

Title: JWT Token Leak / Replay Attack
Description: Stolen or replayed JWTs can impersonate users.
Justification: Tokens travel across boundary each request.
Possible Mitigation(s): Use HTTPS, short expiry, verify signature, rotate tokens.

Title: SQL Injection via Scan Input
Interaction: Store / Retrieve Users, Scans, Findings, Threats [PostgreSQL : 5432]
Description: Unvalidated input can modify DB queries.
Justification: Dynamic queries may be used to store scan data.

Title: Unauthorized ZAP API Access
Description: Open ZAP API allows unauthorized scan triggers or report downloads.
Justification: ZAP listens on port 8080 by default.
Possible Mitigation(s): Bind to localhost, API key, firewall rules.

Title: Out-of-Scope Scanning / DoS
Description: ZAP may hit unauthorized targets or overload sites.
Justification: No scope check before scan launch.
Possible Mitigation(s): Domain allowlist, logging, rate limit, user authorization.

Title: Sensitive Data Exposure in Findings
Description: Reports may contain cookies, tokens, internal URLs
Possible Mitigation(s): Sanitize output, mask secrets, role-based access.

Title: Excessive Database Privileges
Interaction: Store / Retrieve Users, Scans, Findings, Threats [PostgreSQL : 5432]
Description: DB account has superuser rights or open 5432 port.
Possible Mitigation(s): Least privilege roles, restrict network, rotate creds.

Title: Stored XSS in Scan Results
Description: Malicious payload stored in report executes on display.
